stories.title: Audio long read: The air is full of DNA — here’s what scientists are using it for
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 11 May 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01522-8Floating genetic material could give insights into ecosystem health, the presence of invasive species, and help researchers identify pathogens before they cause harm.
